name: DIII-D_301x521
description: DIII-D tokamak (General Atomics, San Diego), 301x521 mesh. One of the five meshes (82x142, 100x172, 151x261, 213x368, 301x521) used in the validation studies. Domain R in [0.15, 3.0] m, Z in [-1.75, 1.75] m; the Z range covers the full poloidal-field coil set (coils.txt spans Z in [-1.622, 1.622] m). The five configurations differ only in npr and npz.
